newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH IPB SAYS TO LOWER RATES FEB 18.
newsitem.headline: CZECH IPB SAYS TO LOWER RATES FEB 18.

text.p: IPB a.s., the Czech Republic's fourth largest commercial bank, said on Friday it would lower lending rates by between 30 and 70 basis points, effective February 18.
The bank said in a statement that short-term rates would be lowered to 12.8 percent, while mid-terms would fall to 13.8 percent and long-terms to 14.9 percent.
The statement did not say by how much each rate was lowered, nor did it give specific details on the length of each terms. IPB officials were not immediately available for comment.
